assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create exactly one opaque panoramic 2D fighting-game stage master for Resident Evil Combat. Image1 gives the plaza street level: large weathered stone institutional facade with tall windows, red-and-blue hanging banners, a pale derelict bus along the back street and old abandoned cars, curved pale stone curb and dark paving. Image2 gives the clock tower identity: square warm stone tower with a large luminous white circular clock face, classical masonry bands and a pointed peaked roof cornice. Combine those observed same-location elements into one coherent sideways view of the square at night. Keep the bus and cars at the back, the tower farther behind the side facade, subtly wet stone and asphalt, warm facade lamps against a deep charcoal sky, restrained traces of distant smoke. No character, Nemesis, other monster, weapon, UI, item marker or subtitle. Remove readable street signs, banners' heraldic text and brands. Do not copy the 1999 clocktower courtyard, no modern skyscrapers, no medieval castle interior. Source-guided adaptation of the combat view, without claiming exact ground-plan equivalence.
